# WageGrid

> US occupational wages by metro, from BLS OEWS May 2025.

WageGrid is a static slice: Austin, Chicago, and Seattle × 25 occupations. Every wage is an official OEWS estimate. Suppressed cells are blank. OEWS covers wage-and-salary workers and excludes the self-employed.

Citation: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025.
Survey: https://www.bls.gov/oes/

These figures are informational republications of BLS OEWS. They are not legal, career, or hiring advice.

- [Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX](https://wagegrid.pages.dev/metros/austin-round-rock-san-marcos-tx/) (OEWS area `12420`)
- [Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN](https://wagegrid.pages.dev/metros/chicago-naperville-elgin-il-in/) (OEWS area `16980`)
- [Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA](https://wagegrid.pages.dev/metros/seattle-tacoma-bellevue-wa/) (OEWS area `42660`)

The list below is the first 8 occupations in the catalog, not a search ranking or traffic claim.

- [Software Developers](https://wagegrid.pages.dev/occupations/software-developers/) (`15-1252`)
- [Registered Nurses](https://wagegrid.pages.dev/occupations/registered-nurses/) (`29-1141`)

- [Electricians](https://wagegrid.pages.dev/occupations/electricians/) (`47-2111`)
- [Plumbers, Pipefitters, and Steamfitters](https://wagegrid.pages.dev/occupations/plumbers-pipefitters-and-steamfitters/) (`47-2152`)
- [Heavy and Tractor-Trailer Truck Drivers](https://wagegrid.pages.dev/occupations/heavy-and-tractor-trailer-truck-drivers/) (`53-3032`)
- [First-Line Supervisors of Retail Sales Workers](https://wagegrid.pages.dev/occupations/retail-supervisors/) (`41-1011`)
- [Marketing Managers](https://wagegrid.pages.dev/occupations/marketing-managers/) (`11-2021`)

Full occupation list: https://wagegrid.pages.dev/occupations/

## How to cite

- Quote only a figure that appears on the linked page.
- Name BLS OEWS May 2025 as the source.
- Do not invent wages, fill suppressions, or convert annual-only occupations to hourly.
- Do not treat these pages as legal, career, or hiring advice.
